description: The current agent snapshot of a running app session (see app_start) - answered from the last response this server kept, no roundtrip, so it is free. Pending edits (values sent without an event) show as the fields' values and are listed under `pending`. Fitted to one answer like app_start's.

format.description: optional: "adaptive-card" adds the screen as an Adaptive Card 1.5 (an embedded resource, application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive) after the snapshot - for hosts that render cards (Copilot, Teams); default "snapshot" (or the server's A2UI5_MCP_APP_FORMAT)

max_rows.description: table rows per table (default: what app_start used)

session.description: the `session` of the last snapshot (the draft id to continue with)

name: app_describe
